seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How the IIV collects, uses and protects personal data on the institutional portal.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.lead: Our commitment to protecting the personal data of the portal's users.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The Veterinary Research Institute (IIV) is the controller responsible for the processing of personal data collected through this portal.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.body: We collect only the data strictly necessary: name, e-mail and message (in the contact form); access credentials (in the restricted area); and anonymised technical browsing data (access logs and IP address for security purposes).

purpose.title: 3. Purpose
purpose.body: Data is used to respond to requests, manage laboratory services, comply with legal obligations and improve the portal's user experience.

retention.title: 4. Retention
retention.body: Data is retained for the period strictly necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or for the periods required by law.

rights.title: 5. Data subject rights
rights.bodyBefore: The data subject has the right to access, rectify, erase and object to the processing of their data. To exercise these rights, contact us at

security.title: 6. Security
security.body: We adopt appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration or improper disclosure.
